dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Begins to sort shapes and colors
Shows interest in how things work
activities: Exploring cause and effect with simple toys
watchFor: Shows frustration when faced with problems
Does not engage in play activities
Lacks interest in exploring surroundings

dimensions.title: Language
watchFor: Limited verbal communication
Does not imitate sounds or words
Shows no interest in listening to books or stories

dimensions.title: Physical
activities: Encouraging outdoor play like running and kicking
Participating in simple dance or movement activities
watchFor: Difficulty with walking or running
Avoidance of physical play
Shows little interest in physical activities

dimensions.title: Social
milestones: Begins to engage in parallel play
Can imitate simple actions of others
activities: Playing with peers in community or playgroups
watchFor: Exhibits aggressive behavior towards others
Shows lack of interest in playing with peers
Exhibits extreme shyness or withdrawal in social settings

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Begins to understand feelings of others
activities: Using puppets to express different feelings
watchFor: Excessive tantrums or emotional outbursts
Difficulty calming down
Shows lack of attachment or response to caregivers

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Shows interest in how objects work
activities: Offering hands-on activities like water play
watchFor: Reluctance to explore new things
Lack of interest in new experiences
Avoids engaging with novel objects

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on an activity for a few minutes
Begins to show interest in books
activities: Using puzzles and games that require focus
watchFor: Shows little attention to tasks
Struggles to engage in favorite activities
Easily distracted and unable to complete short tasks

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Feeds self with fingers or a spoon
activities: Providing simple clothing items to practice dressing
watchFor: Refuses to try new self-care tasks
Shows no interest in independent play or activities
Expresses anxiety when separating from parents
